email_draft.subject: Hampton Roads' 2,800 IEPs, less paperwork | Journify
email_draft.body:
Virginia's SPP compliance cycle hits every October, and for a district managing roughly 2,800 IEPs across a military-connected population, the re-evaluation and transfer workload alone is a full-time job that never shows up on any official headcount.

Your case managers and related-service providers are likely running the same documentation cycle twice for every student who transfers in or out of a base-adjacent school. Journify integrates with your existing IEP system and gives your whole SPED team, teachers, paraprofessionals, OT, PT, SLP, a shared workspace where IEP materials generate in less than five minutes. That means less time rebuilding present levels on intake and more time in front of students.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this week so I can show you what it looks like inside a district your size?
